name: Leg Press

beats.label: Bend
beats.cue: Set both feet flat on the plate.

beats.label: Brace
beats.cue: Brace; keep your back against the pad.

beats.label: Press
beats.cue: Push the plate away through both feet.

beats.label: Finish
beats.cue: Keep knees soft at the finish.

beats.label: Return
beats.cue: Bend hips and knees under control.

beats.label: Reset
beats.cue: Keep your heels down before pressing again.

setup: Sit against the back pad and hold the side handles.
Place both feet on the plate; keep heels supported.
Control the return and stop before your back rounds.

advice.tip: Keep your back supported and press through both feet without snapping your knees straight.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back off the pad.
Lifting the heels off the plate.
